title: Weak Permission is not Well-Founded, Grounded and Stable
reasoning: The paper focuses on formal deontic logic and non-monotonic reasoning semantics (logic programming and structured argumentation). While deontic logic is the logic of obligations and permissions (normative reasoning), this is a mathematical/logical proof regarding the properties of specific semantics and does not evaluate or benchmark morals, ethics, or religion in the context of AI models or human values.
